scope: Only design.png, first six tiles of keys/revisions/board-v1.png, selected source 16-frame sheet, and selected source six-key sheet where present. No builder notes, prior critiques, or tests inspected.
inspection_method: Actual view_image inspection of every listed image.
subject: fan
evidence: The lopsided outer housing, tiny crossed/scribbled central hub, low trapezoid base and horizontal base scribble persist across all six keys.
The three interior rotor arms change phase around the same hub while the housing and base stay stable, making the required rotor mechanism readable.
must_not_be_lost: The irregular housing contour, original scribbled hub and base, and exposed overrun strokes.
A fixed housing/base and a common rotor center across all phase drawings.
source_note: Six anchors are accepted as procedural rotor phases; exact filmed blade angles are not required. This verdict does not assess rotation direction, timing, or interpolation.
